could be used to determine values of v and λ. You should draw a diagram, on page 3, showing
the arrangement of your equipment. In your account you should pay particular attention to
• the procedure to be followed,
• the measurements to be taken,
• the control of variables,
• the analysis of the data,
• any safety precautions to be taken.
